title: Briefing for 2026-09-22
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-22: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.

Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike. Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged. 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices. Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household.
global: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war. CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban. Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'. Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan. Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial. Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate.
philippines: CNN, MS NOW, Politico suing Trump over White House ban. Firms’ zero dividends ‘mismatch’ with Sara Duterte net worth | The wRap. Turkey launches AI initiative ahead of COP31 climate summit. Senate approves school safety bill after fatal shootings.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
